_meta.project: License Management System (Python port of License_Management_WBS.xlsx)
_meta.stack: FastAPI + SQLAlchemy 2.0 async + Alembic + PostgreSQL + redis-py + arq; Next.js admin/activation UI; pytest + locust.

fields.id: Stable feature id `<task>-<letter>` (e.g. 2.2-e). One observable behavior per entry.
fields.behavior: The observable behavior this feature must exhibit.
fields.verification: Runnable command that PROVES the behavior. Exit 0 = pass.
fields.evidence: Filled by the verifier on a pass: {date, command, output_excerpt, artifact}. null until proven.

rules: One task IN_PROGRESS at a time (RULES.md).
A feature flips to PASSING only when its `verification` command exits 0.
`state`/`evidence` are written by verify_task.py, never by hand.
Rule 9: a task in PROGRESS.md is DONE only when ALL its behaviors are PASSING.
